tools.description: Check a deliverable and its title / description / tags / privacy / thumbnail / captions (and, on YouTube, description chapters, the scheduled time and localized metadata) against the platform's upload limits, and the deliverable against ffmpeg-skill's delivery spec (`check`), offline (structured FAIL with a fix per row, nothing uploaded; exit 1 unless the verdict is PASS or WARN)

Upload a deliverable, its thumbnail and captions to a platform (YouTube: the Data API v3 resumable upload; Vimeo: the tus resumable upload, title, description and privacy only; TikTok: the Content Posting API Direct Post, title and privacy only; X: the chunked media upload and one public post, its text the title; LinkedIn: the Videos API multipart upload and one public post, its commentary the title; Facebook: the Resumable Upload API and one Page video, title, description and privacy (public or unlisted) only; Instagram Reels: a resumable REELS container, the rupload upload and media_publish, the caption the title). Dry run unless --confirm carries the token the dry run printed for exactly this file, metadata and platform; then a receipt, redacted

Upload the clips a manifest lists (Shorts / Reels cut from one source), in order, each with its own title, a link back to the full video and its own confirmation token (the same gate as upload); a state file makes a re-run resume at the first clip not uploaded and never sends a clip twice; a clip with an unknown outcome blocks the series until a human resolves it. Dry run unless --confirm

privacy.values.api_default: public (this skill defaults to private: see ADR-002)
privacy.values.quote: Valid values for this property are: private public unlisted

quota.captions_insert_units.quote: A call to this method has a quota cost of 400 units.

quota.thumbnails_set_units.quote: A call to this method has a quota cost of approximately 50 units.

quota.videos_insert.quote: Quota impact: 100 calls per day. A call to this method has a quota cost of 1 unit in the Video Uploads quota bucket.
quota.videos_insert.value: 100 calls per day; 1 unit each in the Video Uploads quota bucket

schedule.publish_at.checked_as: RFC 3339 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, optional fraction, then Z or an offset +HH:MM / -HH:MM: a time without an offset is ambiguous), and --privacy private; not checked against the clock (plan is deterministic): a past time publishes the video immediately
schedule.publish_at.quote: The date and time when the video is scheduled to publish. It can be set only if the privacy status of the video is private.
schedule.publish_at.value: ISO 8601 date and time; only with privacy private

tags.max_chars.quote: The property value has a maximum length of 500 characters. ... commas between items in the list count toward the limit. If a tag contains a space, the API server handles the tag value as though it were wrapped in quotation marks, and the quotation marks count toward the character limit.

tags.max_chars_per_tag.note: no per-tag limit is stated; only the 500-character total is checked

tags.max_count.note: no limit on the number of tags is stated; only the 500-character total is checked

thumbnail.min_width_px.quote: We recommend your custom thumbnails: Have a resolution of 3840 x 2160 pixels for videos ..., with a minimum width of 640 pixels for videos
thumbnail.min_width_px.why_not_checked: a recommendation, and plan does not decode images

thumbnail.types.quote: Accepted Media MIME types: image/jpeg , image/png , application/octet-stream

title.forbidden_chars.quote: may contain all valid UTF-8 characters except < and >.

title.max_chars.quote: The property value has a maximum length of 100 characters and may contain all valid UTF-8 characters except < and >.

uploads.per_user.note: the API returns uploadLimitExceeded when "the user has exceeded the number of videos they may upload" but states no number

video.file_formats.mapping: .MPEG-1/.MPEG-2/.MPEG4 -> .mpeg; 3GPP -> .3gp/.3gpp; WebM -> .webm; DNxHR, ProRes, CineForm and HEVC are codecs (their container is one of the others); the rest as written
video.file_formats.quote: make sure that you're using one of the following formats: .MOV .MPEG-1 .MPEG-2 .MPEG4 .MP4 .MPG .AVI .WMV .MPEGPS .FLV 3GPP WebM DNxHR ProRes CineForm HEVC (H.265)

video.max_duration_s.quote: The maximum file size you can upload is 256 GB or 12 hours, whichever is less.

video.mime_types.quote: Accepted Media MIME types: video/* , application/octet-stream

video.unverified_max_duration_s.applies_to: accounts that are not verified (plan cannot tell, so it warns)
video.unverified_max_duration_s.quote: By default, you can upload videos that are up to 15 minutes long. Verified accounts can upload videos longer than 15 minutes.
